answer: A new agent may use a numbered jetty slip only during the 7-minute comet-culmination window on the public ephemeris. Thirty-six hours earlier they bury a signed temperature logger on the east dune, then capture a 40-second hydrophone clip of that slip's pilings. The clerk seals clip, serial, and 0.1°C series, admitting the applicant only if the 16-band spectrogram hash is unique across 90 days and the serial is unused as a sponsor. A Hamming-near family (distance <= 3) or reused serial burns 70 units and bars both for a season; one logger graduates one agent every 21 days.
